steps.en: Indicator already applied to all outstanding notices of the offender
steps.id: Indicator sudah dipasang ke semua notice outstanding milik offender

steps.en: Indicator IDs are re-checked every X days, configurable by the officer
steps.id: ID ber-indicator dicek ulang tiap X hari, bisa diatur petugas
steps.why_en: Checks run on a fixed monthly schedule for everyone, not every X days from each person's indicator date.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan jalan bulanan tetap untuk semua orang, bukan tiap X hari dari tanggal indicator masing-masing.

steps.en: NRIC IDs are sent to the immigration authority for their latest address
steps.id: ID NRIC dikirim ke otoritas imigrasi untuk minta alamat terbarunya
steps.why_en: Sending goes through the MHA channel for NRIC only; the ICA link itself cannot be confirmed from the code.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman lewat jalur MHA khusus NRIC; sambungan ke ICA sendiri tidak bisa dipastikan dari code.

steps.en: FIN and UEN IDs are sent to the second agency for their address
steps.id: ID FIN dan UEN dikirim ke instansi kedua untuk minta alamatnya
steps.why_en: The code exists but is switched off in the production settings, and the agency named in the story cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Code-nya ada tetapi dimatikan di setting produksi, dan instansi yang disebut di story tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: The latest registered address comes back and is stored for comparison
steps.id: Alamat terdaftar terbaru kembali dan disimpan untuk dibandingkan
steps.why_en: Results are stored, but each person's row is overwritten every cycle and a needed tag column is never filled.
steps.why_id: Hasil disimpan, tetapi satu baris per orang ditimpa tiap siklus dan kolom penanda yang dibutuhkan tidak pernah diisi program.

steps.en: OCMS compares the received address with the one it holds
steps.id: OCMS membandingkan alamat yang diterima dengan alamat yang dipegang
steps.why_en: Comparison exists only inside a report, is not stored per person, and relies on a tag column never filled.
steps.why_id: Perbandingan hanya ada di laporan, tidak disimpan per orang, dan bergantung pada kolom penanda yang tidak pernah diisi.
